Today, James went to the restaurant. Between what times could they have gone?
We know that:
James woke up at 12pm.
Elizabeth saw James stretching at a yoga studio from 3pm to 4pm.
Michael saw James fixing their computer at the electronic store from 4pm to 7pm.
Mary saw James working at the office from 7pm to 9pm.
Nancy saw James working out at the gym from 9pm to 10pm.
The restaurant was closed after 10pm.
Between what times could James have gone to the restaurant?

Options:
(A) 12pm to 3pm
(B) 3pm to 4pm
(C) 7pm to 9pm
(D) 9pm to 10pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- James was at the electronic store from 4pm to 7pm, so he couldn't have gone to the restaurant between 4pm and 7pm.

The only time frame that fits all these conditions is between 3pm and 4pm, as it is the first available time after James woke up and before he was seen at the yoga studio.

Answer: (B)
